description: This file defines the command-line interface (CLI) for Playwright, including commands for opening browsers, generating code, installing browsers, and managing browser dependencies. It sets up command parsing, options, and associated actions, and includes utility functions for browser context management and command execution.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: Type definition for CLI options related to browser launch and configuration.

classes.name: CaptureOptions
classes.description: Type definition for options related to capturing screenshots or PDFs.

methods.name: launchContext
methods.description: Sets up and launches a browser context based on provided options, returning the browser, context, and a close function.

methods.name: openPage
methods.description: Opens a new page in the given browser context, navigating to a URL if provided.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Launches a browser context and opens a page at the specified URL.

methods.name: codegen
methods.description: Starts recording user actions on a page and generates code in the specified language.

methods.name: maybeSetupTestHooks
methods.description: Sets up hooks for testing, including crash detection and process exit handling.

methods.name: waitForPage
methods.description: Waits for specified selector or timeout on a page before proceeding.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of a webpage at a URL with specified options.

methods.name: pdf
methods.description: Generates a PDF of a webpage at a URL with specified options, only supported for Chromium.

methods.name: lookupBrowserType
methods.description: Determines the Playwright browser type based on options.

methods.name: logErrorAndExit
methods.description: Logs an error and exits the process.

methods.name: commandWithOpenOptions
methods.description: Creates a command with common open options for browsers.

methods.name: buildBasePlaywrightCLICommand
methods.description: Constructs the base CLI command string based on language.
